title: Content
author: 64cf7168c6edd65797781320
chapter_outcomes: Students will be able to draft an essay between 120-160 words to support a specific position on a given statement.
Students will be able to construct an introduction featuring a broad background statement and a clearly defined thesis.
Students will be able to formulate topic sentences that distinctly state the main point of a body paragraph.
Students will be able to provide relevant reasons and examples to substantiate their topic sentences.
Students will be able to summarize the central idea of a paragraph to ensure cohesive argumentation.
Students will be able to evaluate both sides of an argument before settling on a definitive stance in the conclusion.
Students will be able to summarize body paragraph ideas in the conclusion without introducing new information.
Students will be able to articulate their final stance clearly using appropriate linking words and a formal tone.
